snapshot.ldtHeadSubject: fix(inspect): flood-hazard-fact on node facets, SS-W16 stays (#449)

missionPremise: Sellable WDLL item 5: a land-use-fact atom that exists for a gold parcel must be retrievable by that parcel's parcelNodeId on inspect. Flood PR 449 proved the sibling-field pattern (floodHazardFact). Land-use entity_id is ${parcelNodeId}:${taxYear} (writer seam land-use-fact-writer.ts), so flood's entity_id = ANY(parcel keys) WILL MISS 48021:34137:2025. Baked facets.baseFacts.landUse stays retiredStore this pass. Item 6: no new ingest. Source: _dispatches/2026-08-21_s7-land-use-inspect_dispatch.md, hauska-engine packages/atoms/src/land-use-fact-writer.ts entityIdOf, _inbox/2026-08-21_sellable_WDLL.md items 5 and 6.
completionPredicate: GET /api/brokerage/v1/place/node/:parcelNodeId/facets returns a ROOT sibling landUseFact read from land-use-fact atoms (prefixes + taxYear bind), or a typed refusal code=atom-miss that names both parcel prefixes. Never a silent null. Never SELECT cad_property for that field. facets.baseFacts.landUse remains the baked cad-roll object. Tests fail if cad-roll code/description is copied onto landUseFact, and pass when a fixture atom on 48021:34137:2025 yields landUseCode. Diff uncommitted. No deploy, no atoms --apply, no Harris PBF, no minted absence.
scopeBasis: New READ of existing land-use-fact atoms on the cortex inspect GET only, copied from floodHazardFactRead. Dual grammar is on the parcel PREFIX only, then :taxYear from the atom row, never invented from cad_property or the request. Keep baked landUse. Do not write hauska-map. Do not occupy the property seat checkout. Deploy is planner leave_behind.

bindSql.notThis: entity_id = ANY($2::text[]) of parcel keys (floodHazardFactRead). That lookup misses ${parcel}:${taxYear}.
bindSql.this: SELECT entity_id, body FROM atoms WHERE entity_type = $1 AND (entity_id LIKE $2 || ':%' OR entity_id LIKE $3 || ':%')
bindSql.taxYear: suffix after a matching prefix. Parsed from the atom row (entity_id and/or body.taxYear). Never a request param. Never cad_property.tax_year.
bindSql.prefer: highest taxYear among prefix hits. Same year on both grammars: integer first if bodies agree; bind-conflict if they disagree.

retiredStoreUnchanged.facets.baseFacts.landUse: keep baked cad-roll {code, description, source, vintage} this pass. PE will prefer landUseFact.
retiredStoreUnchanged.never: SELECT cad_property for landUseFact. Never copy code/description onto landUseFact.

newReadPath.store: ATOMS_DATABASE_URL -> hauska_mcp.atoms. Never DATABASE_URL (deployment store in api-server).
newReadPath.pool: module-level singleton, not a new Pool per GET

divergenceInTests.atomFixture: landUseCode distinct from A1 (fixture C1), landUseLabel not the cad-roll description
divergenceInTests.why: a test that seeds the same code on both stores can pass while still serving cad-roll. Distinct values plus atom field names (landUseCode not code) prove which store answered.

whatWillViolateToProveTests: interpret empty rows / flood-style entity_id without :taxYear => atom-miss, not null
memory fake query containing cad_property or place_layer_snapshots throws
GET with snapshot A1 and empty atoms: landUseFact.code undefined, landUseFact is atom-miss, baked landUse.code stays A1
GET with snapshot A1 and fixture 48021:34137:2025 landUseCode=C1: landUseFact.landUseCode=C1 source=land-use-fact, baked landUse.code still A1
same year both grammars disagree: bind-conflict
boot-proof: brokerageNodeFacets.ts imports landUseFactRead and emits landUseFact
read module source has zero cad_property / FROM place_layer_snapshots; has FROM atoms and LIKE prefix

threeQuestionGate.control: unit tests on prefix bind + year prefer + cad_property refusal, plus route boot-proof
threeQuestionGate.whatExecutesIt: vitest in artifacts/api-server (CI Test job on PR; this lane does not open a PR)
threeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: local vitest this lane; later PR/push to main (planner)
threeQuestionGate.whatFailsWhenViolated: vitest non-zero if landUseFact carries cad-roll code/description, if miss is a silent null, if flood-style parcel-only ids bind, or if the route does not import the new module
threeQuestionGate.whatBypassesIt: a second route that SELECT cad_property onto a differently named field. Tests assert landUseFact.source is land-use-fact and landUseFact has landUseCode not code.

bakedLandUseStaysRetiredStore.falsifier: GET stops returning facets.baseFacts.landUse.code from the bake, or landUseFact is populated from that object

landUseFactNeverCadProperty.expect: landUseFactRead.ts has zero cad_property tokens; memory fake throws on that name
landUseFactNeverCadProperty.falsifier: a SELECT cad_property in the new module, or a passing test whose landUseFact.code equals the bake

floodStyleAnyParcelKeysMiss.expect: rows keyed 48021:34137 (no :year) are atom-miss for land-use
floodStyleAnyParcelKeysMiss.falsifier: interpret serves a present finding from a parcel-only entity_id

dualGrammarPrefixesAlwaysTwo.expect: landUseFactBindPrefixes('48021:34137') and inbound padded both equal ['48021:34137','48021:34137.00000000']
dualGrammarPrefixesAlwaysTwo.falsifier: a third key, a missing padded form, or inbound padded not inverted

missIsNamedRefusal.expect: code atom-miss with tried prefixes, landUseFact not null
missIsNamedRefusal.falsifier: landUseFact omitted or null with no code

gold48021.expect: fixture 48021:34137:2025 yields landUseCode; live store UNMEASURED until a point lookup this lane can run without apply
gold48021.falsifier: silent null, or a value whose source is cad-roll / cad_property

adversarialReview.objection: LIKE prefix || ':%' might match padded ids from the integer prefix.
adversarialReview.response: 48021:34137.00000000:2025 does not LIKE 48021:34137:% because the next character after the integer prefix is '.' not ':'. Interpret additionally requires rest === YYYY against each prefix independently.
adversarialReview.disposition: Proceed. Test both prefixes as distinct hits.

adversarialReview.objection: Inventing taxYear from cad_property or from the request would bind even when the atom is missing.
adversarialReview.response: Year comes from the atom row. tried names prefixes only. Zero hits is atom-miss.

adversarialReview.objection: Copying bake landUse onto landUseFact would pass a naive presence check.
adversarialReview.response: Divergence fixture: bake A1 vs atom C1. Assert landUseCode not code. Assert baked A1 still on baseFacts.
